Sandbox_ZLRC_enableMod_tooltip: Master switch for every fix in this patch.
Sandbox_ZLRC_debug_tooltip: Prints [ZLRC] lines to the console log. Turn on when reporting a problem.
Sandbox_ZLRC_stripGuard: Non-hostile A-Life NPCs do not trigger ZomboDesire/ZomboLust catch + strip
Sandbox_ZLRC_stripGuard_tooltip: Bumping into, running into or stepping on an A-Life NPC that is not hostile to you no longer fires the zombie catch / clothing-strip logic.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcIgnoreSubdued: A-Life NPCs ignore subdued zombies and NPCs
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcIgnoreSubdued_tooltip: A-Life NPCs will not target, shoot or kill anything subdued with ZomboRut, and Jeem residents will not sweep or carry it away.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcIgnoreDragged: Jeem residents ignore corpses you are dragging
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcIgnoreDragged_tooltip: Residents will not try to pick up or move a corpse while a player is dragging it (or it is a ZomboRut scene husk).
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcSexEnabled: Friendly A-Life NPCs appear in ZomboRut's "Ask for Sex" menu
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcSexEnabled_tooltip: Adds available ZomboRut positions to the Ask for Sex menu for friendly or allied A-Life NPCs, based on the player/NPC gender pair: FM and MF get Holding, Standing Doggy, Spooning, Footjob and Doggy; FM also gets Cowgirl and MF gets Missionary. Under More..., FM/MF get Blowjob and FM gets Cowgirl (variant); FF gets Cowgirl, Face sit and Reverse lotus. MM has no options.
Sandbox_ZLRC_persistCaptives: Keep subdued A-Life NPCs subdued after leaving and returning to the area
Sandbox_ZLRC_persistCaptives_tooltip: Stores the captive state on the NPC's A-Life record and re-applies it when the NPC is spawned back in. Also stops downed captives from bleeding out.
Sandbox_ZLRC_showBik: Show the ZomboLust video window during ZomboRut scenes
Sandbox_ZLRC_showBik_tooltip: Plays the matching ZomboLust Bink (.bik) video in the same window ZomboLust uses.
Sandbox_ZLRC_excitationSource_tooltip: Which nearby bodies raise ZomboLust excitation (pheromones). 'Zombies' means real zombies; 'NPCs' means A-Life NPCs.
Sandbox_ZLRC_cleanEnabled: Allow rinsing subdued NPCs / zombies / corpses
Sandbox_ZLRC_cleanEnabled_tooltip: Adds a right-click 'Rinse off' option when you carry a container with water.
Sandbox_ZLRC_noCloakAfterNpc: No zombie-stench cloak after NPC scenes or with washed bodies
Sandbox_ZLRC_noCloakAfterNpc_tooltip: ZomboRut's stench cloak (zombie scent moodle) is not granted after a scene with an A-Life NPC or with a body you have washed.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcDefeatEnabled: Hostile A-Life NPCs take a surrendered / exhausted player (ZomboRut)
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcDefeatEnabled_tooltip: Master switch for the surrender path: when you give up (or are exhausted with a hostile NPC engaging you) hostile NPCs stop attacking, walk up to you and play a ZomboRut defeat scene.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcDefeatExhaustion_tooltip: How worn out you must be (100 = no endurance left) while a hostile NPC engages you before you give up automatically. Only used when ZomboRut's defeat mode includes exhaustion.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcDefeatChance_tooltip: Chance that the exhaustion auto-surrender fires once its conditions have held for 1.5 s. If it fails, it is retried after 10 s.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcEngageRadius_tooltip: A hostile NPC inside this distance counts as engaging you.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcCallRadius: Hostile NPCs that join an active give-up (tiles)
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcCallRadius_tooltip: When you are already giving up (hotkey, menu or zombies), hostile NPCs within this distance come to you. Surrender-chain scans always cover at least 20 tiles.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcJoinGiveUp: Hostile NPCs join a give-up that is already active
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcJoinGiveUp_tooltip: Off: only the exhaustion auto-surrender starts NPC encounters.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcMaxTakers_tooltip: How many hostile NPCs take their turn one after another (ZomboRut-style chain) before the encounter ends. Default is 8. Waiting NPCs gather near you meanwhile.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcTriggerRange: NPC distance that triggers the scene (tiles)
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcTriggerRange_tooltip: The NPC walks/runs until it is this close, then the scene starts.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcApproachTimeout_tooltip: If an NPC cannot reach you in this time it is skipped.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcShieldGiveUp: A-Life NPCs do not attack a player who is giving up or in a scene
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcShieldGiveUp_tooltip: While ZomboRut's give-up machine or a ZomboRut scene is active on you, A-Life NPCs cannot target or hurt you.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcGraceSeconds: NPC safe window after the last scene (seconds)
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcGraceSeconds_tooltip: A-Life NPCs keep leaving you alone this long after the last NPC chain scene. Default is 200 seconds; increase it if pain or muscle strain makes it hard to get away. ZomboRut's own escape/ghost window separately protects you from zombies.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcDefeatCooldown: Cooldown before the next NPC encounter (seconds)
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcDefeatCooldown_tooltip: Counted from the end of an encounter that had at least one scene.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcChainGuard: Non-hostile NPCs never take part in the chain
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcChainGuard_tooltip: When ZomboRut's own chain nominates a friendly or neutral A-Life NPC, a hostile NPC takes the turn instead (or the give-up simply ends). Off: any NPC ZomboRut nominates is used.
Sandbox_ZLRC_lustNpcEnabled: Hostile NPCs react to ZomboLust excitation
Sandbox_ZLRC_lustNpcEnabled_tooltip: A hostile opposite-gender NPC near an excited player walks up and starts ZomboDesire's contact scene (strip, animation, minigame) instead of attacking. ZomboLust's own bite-chance roll still applies on contact.
Sandbox_ZLRC_lustNpcMinExcitation_toolti: Below this ZomboLust excitation hostile NPCs just attack.
Sandbox_ZLRC_lustNpcChance: NPC excitation encounter chance at full excitation (%)
Sandbox_ZLRC_lustNpcChance_tooltip: The actual chance scales with your excitation (at 50% excitation and 100 here: 50%). Rolled once per NPC every 20 s.
Sandbox_ZLRC_lustNpcRadius: Hostile NPCs that react to excitation (tiles)
Sandbox_ZLRC_lustNpcRadius_tooltip: Hostile NPCs inside this distance can be drawn in.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcQueue: Other hostile NPCs wait near the player during a scene
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcQueue_tooltip: Every hostile NPC in earshot is called in and waits close to you (outside ZomboRut's scene-fade area) while another one has its scene, then takes its turn. Off: NPCs are only called one at a time and may wander off meanwhile.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcKeepClothes: NPCs keep their clothes in scenes
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcKeepClothes_tooltip: ZomboRut drops a zombie attacker's trousers on the ground for the scene. For A-Life NPCs that is skipped: the clothing is hidden for the scene and shown again afterwards, nothing lands on the ground.
Sandbox_ZLRC_bikAutoOpen: Bik video window opens by itself when a scene starts
Sandbox_ZLRC_bikAutoOpen_tooltip: Off (default): the current clip is loaded but the window stays closed; open it by hand (ZomboLust sidebar button) and it shows what is playing. On: the window pops up at every scene like in ZomboLust.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcDangerRadius: NPC scenes are cancelled when zombies / other factions are this close (tiles)
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcDangerRadius_tooltip: Failsafe. If plain zombies (not A-Life NPCs) or friendly NPCs of another faction are within this distance of you, hostile NPCs do not start a scene: they are released and deal with the threat themselves. 0 = off.
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcHoldPost: Queued NPCs are held at a post (like outpost guards)
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcHoldPost_tooltip: Waiting hostile NPCs get a temporary A-Life 'garrison' order at a spot near you, so they stand there instead of wandering off. Off: only A-Life's movement call and the zombie AI are used (NPCs may wander).
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcSatisfy: Arousal reset after an NPC scene
Sandbox_ZLRC_npcSatisfy_tooltip: After a hostile-NPC scene or a ZomboDesire NPC scene ZomboLust excitation is set to 0 and ZomboRut's arousal is released with full relief (the 'satisfied' state), then 0.
